assets.name: frame
promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept. The TWO attached images are STYLE and PROPORTION references:
Ascension's Faucheur class-resource HUD as rendered, and its component atlas. Match their SIMPLE
hand-painted Warcraft UI style precisely: broad painted light/shadow facets, chunky dark
outline, soft upper-left light, very sparse surface detail, legibility at tiny game size. Do not
reproduce green or purple, skulls or scythes. No photorealistic materials, no high-frequency
scratches, no ornate decoration, no text. Generate ONLY a wide horizontal weapon FRAME, not an
assembled HUD. Two identical straight ROMAN GLADII, mirrored left/right, points facing OUTWARD
to far left and far right. Long dark worn iron blades, straight double edges, aged bronze
guards/pommels, simple leather grips. Tips raised slightly; both swords form a SHALLOW
symmetrical V, never a steep X. Hilts overlap and cross LOW at canvas centre, joined by a small
round dark bronze boss with an EMPTY round jewel socket. Composition on 512x224 transparent
canvas: left tip at approximately (12,65), right tip (500,65), inner blade roots at (215,135)
and (297,135); crossed grips behind boss at (256,178). These are virtual target coordinates,
scale proportionally if output is larger. Perfectly level bilateral symmetry. Middle-upper band
at x100..410,y30..120 remains clear for three separate helmet sockets. Match silhouette weight
and detail of the reference scythe FRAME at top of atlas, but Roman straight blades. Entire
silhouette inside canvas with 8px margin. No helmets, no jewels, no shield, no glows, no
background. Genuine transparent alpha.
